item: How easy was it to find the main information on the Home page?
How clearly did the Home page present the latest forecast date and data refresh information?
How easy was it to find a company or sector to explore from the Home page?
How easy was it to use the Companies page or search controls to select a specific company (e.g., GLO, BPI, or MEG) and open its company details?
How easy was it to understand the selected company’s historical price and trading-volume information, including the displayed dates and trends?
How clearly did the forecast charts show the difference between actual historical prices and predicted values?
How easy was it to switch between Beginner and Advanced views on a company details page?
How easy was it to add a company to My Watchlist?
How easy was it to find and review the companies saved in My Watchlist?
How clearly did the page explain how many companies could be saved to the watchlist?
How easy was it to find a learning topic on the Learn Stocks page?
How clearly did the learning content explain stock-market or forecasting concepts?
How easy was it to follow the learning path and open its learning materials?
How easy was it to find information about the purpose of PSE Pulse?
How clearly did the About page explain the forecasting methods and how they are evaluated?
How clearly did the page explain the scope and limitations of the forecasts?
How easy was it to find information about the data source and update process?
How easy was it to open Ask AI and start a question?
How clear was the answer provided by Ask AI?
How relevant was the answer to the question you asked?
How clearly did Ask AI explain its educational purpose and limits?
